full_prompt_en: A square fashion illustration shows an elegant woman seated at an outdoor Paris café against a mostly white page. She wears a wide pale-pink hat trimmed with small flowers, dark cat-eye sunglasses, and a fitted blush-pink top with a floral corsage near one shoulder. Her blond hair is twisted into a neat low bun. One hand rises near her lips while the other rests beside a white teacup and saucer on the table. A stemmed glass of amber drink, a small plate, an open magazine, and a pink woven handbag with a light rectangular label complete the foreground still life. In the background, the Eiffel Tower and rows of Parisian buildings are drawn in delicate gray-brown architectural lines, deliberately much lighter than the central figure. The figure's skin and clothing have soft watercolor-like washes of peach, rose, and beige, but their edges are held by fine precise ink outlines. Black sunglasses supply the main dark accent, with a few warm golden glints in the drink and handbag hardware. Much of the paper remains unpainted, so the small city details and tabletop objects feel airy rather than crowded. Light appears clear and diffuse, brightening skin and fabric without heavy cast shadows. The hat brim gives a slight soft shade over the face. Tiny printed lettering is visible on the cup and bag labels but does not dominate the composition. The whole image reads as a lighthearted editorial sketch, combining fashionable polish with casual hand-drawn linework and generous white space.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形时装插画在几乎留白的纸页上描绘一位优雅女子坐在巴黎露天咖啡座。她戴饰有小花的宽檐浅粉帽、深色猫眼太阳镜，穿贴身浅粉上衣，一侧肩旁别着花朵胸饰。金发整齐盘成低髻。一只手抬近嘴边，另一只手放在桌上的白茶杯与杯碟旁。盛琥珀饮品的高脚杯、小盘子、打开的杂志和带浅色长方标签的粉色编织手袋，组成前景静物。背景的埃菲尔铁塔和成排巴黎建筑以细巧灰棕建筑线绘成，有意比中央人物更淡。皮肤与衣服带桃色、玫瑰色和米色的柔水彩般铺色，边缘却由精细准确的墨线约束。黑色太阳镜提供主要深色点，饮品和手袋金属件上有少量暖金闪点。纸面大部分仍未涂满，让城市细节和桌上物件显得轻盈而非拥挤。光线清澈漫射，照亮皮肤与布料，不产生重投影。帽檐在脸上留下轻柔阴影。杯和手袋标签上可见细小印字，但并不主导构图。整幅图是一张轻快编辑速写，把时髦精致感与随意手绘线条、宽裕留白结合。
style_prompt_en: Airy fashion-editorial illustration layers fine precise ink contours with translucent watercolor-like washes on a mostly unpainted white page. Blush pink, peach, beige, and small warm-gold notes carry the soft color; a compact near-black accent provides focus. The central form receives stronger modeling, while surrounding structural detail is indicated by much lighter gray-brown lines and sparse strokes. Crisp small accessories can sit beside loose paper-white intervals, giving the frame an elegant rhythm of detail and absence. Diffuse daylight keeps shadows light and skin-like planes luminous. Slight pencil irregularity and delicate floral marks make the result feel hand-drawn despite its polished composition.
style_prompt_zh: 轻盈时装编辑插画在大体留白的纸页上叠放精细准确的墨线轮廓与半透明水彩般铺色。浅粉、桃色、米色和少量暖金点缀承担柔和调色；紧凑的近黑点色提供焦点。中央形体塑形更强，周围结构细节则由更淡灰棕线和稀疏笔触暗示。清楚的小配件可与松散纸白间隔并置，让画幅有细节与空处交替的优雅节奏。漫射日光让阴影轻薄，皮肤般平面明亮。轻微铅笔不规则与细巧花卉笔痕让精致构图仍有手绘感。
theme_en: A chic traveler at a Paris café in a pale pink fashion sketch
theme_zh: 巴黎咖啡座上的时髦旅人，呈淡粉色时装速写
name: Megan Hess
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
